title: Closeout summary: Contractual link and unlink semantics - non-invasive and reversible
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented non-invasive global link/unlink semantics: global link now offers --init for fresh targets, existing workspace links write only the machine-local registry, global unlink archives by default, and purge requires --yes. Focused link/unlink and command-surface tests passed; pnpm check passed.

Close reason: Link/unlink contract implemented, tested, documented, and committed.
